_comment: Recipe of a release (scripts/release.py). Copy to configs/release_final.json and fill in. Paths are relative to the repository. Everything but name and grid is optional.
name: mtp1_rehearsal
notes: Rehearsal on the development grid. For the final release: grid = your copy of the ablation config on test_v2 / bench_v1, benchmark = data/bench_v1.json, case_studies.runs = the baseline-row run folder of each LLM, extraction = the M9 run folder(s).
